title: Role-Playing Agents Driven by Large Language Models: Current Status, Challenges, and Future Trends

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature (e.g., Yuan et al., 2024) that demonstrates LLM-based automatic scorers tend to exhibit bias by favoring linguistic expression quality and fluency over actual fidelity to the intended character settings.

Discussed conceptually as a limitation in current role-playing agents, highlighting the need for multi-lingual and multi-perspective character systems to avoid biases stemming from a single cultural perspective.
